name: Kettlesnail · Gremlet #11
description:
A snail living in an old copper kettle. It puffs steam when it's thinking.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Kettlesnail in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
